exposure: Red blood cell transfusion (RBCt) in the postpartum period
cohort: 18,674 patients who delivered between January 2018 and December 2021 at a specific center
finding: Among patients with postpartum RBCt, 34.3% lacked an identified PPH, highlighting the importance of diagnosing PPH and postpartum anemia.
mod_finding: Patients receiving RBCt had higher rates of cesarean delivery, twin pregnancy, labor induction, and previous cesarean section.
